name.description: The module's name; also its route (/main/<name>) and folder

project.description: Application the module is added to (default: the first application in angular.json)

path.description: Folder the module's own folder is created in (default: <sourceRoot>/app/modules)

route.description: The module's address under /main/ and its sidebar id (default: the name). Give a ported module the old juicebox's, so links and staff's saved sidebar order keep working

label.description: The module's name as staff read it in the sidebar and the breadcrumb (default: the name, capitalised)

role.description: Role that shows the module in the sidebar (default: <name>:role)

service.description: Backend service the module calls (default: the name, as in the old juicebox generator)

icon.description: Material icon of the sidebar entry

lib.description: Add the module to the juicebar library itself (run in the juicebox-lib repository) instead of to a project

skipSkill.description: Do not write the Claude skill that points at the module guide
